Name: Nyapu-Style Woodsman Hurst
Author: nugmods
Description:
[left]Nyapu Portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45324?tab=description]Hurst[/url], Keeper of the Mistgrove, a curious woodsman with a deep reverence for the Junimos. 

Many thanks as always to Nyapu for their generous permissions, allowing me to use some of their assets and some of my own work to create these portraits, as well as to Sprinton for allowing me to publish these portraits. Go support the release of Woodsman Hurst on Nexus!!

[b]Install Instructions:[/b]
It's a Content Patcher file, so just put it in your mods folder and it will automatically patch Hurst's portraits.
